one_line: Nizam Shahi princess and Adil Shahi queen who defended Ahmednagar and balanced swords with revenue treaties in the Deccan, 1595–1600 CE.

appearance.age_look: Mid-30s, athletic and upright, with the poised bearing of a trained rider and commander.
appearance.face: Oval face with sharp cheekbones, medium-brown Deccan complexion, straight nose, dark arched brows, and large focused anime-style brown eyes; a small beauty mark just below her left eye, default expression calm but resolute with a hint of sternness.
appearance.hair: Thick, dark brown-black hair parted in the middle, gathered into a low, long braid that falls between her shoulder blades; the braid wrapped at intervals with thin gold cords; she wears a deep emerald-green Deccani turban (kulah-style cloth wrap) with a small white heron feather tucked on the left side and a narrow gold band at the base.
appearance.costume: Era-accurate late 16th-century Deccan noblewoman’s riding attire: a long, fitted, front-opening jamah (over-tunic) in muted saffron-gold silk with fine vertical self-stripes and slightly flared skirt reaching mid-calf, fastened with small cloth buttons and a narrow brown leather belt; beneath it, a high-necked, long-sleeved cotton kurta in soft off-white, its cuffs just visible; loose churidar trousers in deep indigo, tightly ruched at the ankles; a substantial dupatta/odhani in rich emerald-green with a narrow gold border, draped from her left shoulder across the torso and around her back so it stays secure while riding; sturdy brown leather riding boots reaching mid-calf with simple stitching; jewellery kept dignified but princely—small gold hoop earrings, a single elegant pearl-and-gold necklace resting above the collarbone, two slim gold bangles on each wrist and a simple gold seal ring on her right hand, suggesting administrative authority.
appearance.signature: A slightly curved Deccani tulwar with a steel blade, a simple cross-guard and disc pommel, its hilt wrapped in dark brown leather, worn at her left hip on a brown leather sword belt; in her left hand she often carries a rolled parchment scroll tied with a red cord, symbolising fiscal treaties and orders.

ref_desc: Chand Bibi is a mid-30s, medium-brown Deccan noblewoman with an oval face, large brown eyes, a left-eye beauty mark, dark braided hair under an emerald-green turban, wearing a saffron-gold jamah over off-white kurta and indigo churidar with boots, carrying a brown-hilted tulwar and a red-tied parchment scroll in a palette of saffron-gold, emerald green, deep indigo, off-white and brown leather.
sheet_prompt: Draw a full-body anime-style character model of Chand Bibi: a mid-30s, athletic Deccan noblewoman with an oval face, medium-brown complexion, sharp cheekbones, straight nose, arched brows and large focused brown eyes with a small beauty mark just below her left eye, expression calm and resolute. Her thick dark brown-black hair is parted in the middle and gathered into a low long braid falling between her shoulder blades, wrapped at intervals with thin gold cords, and she wears an emerald-green turban with a narrow gold band and a small white heron feather on the left. She is fully and modestly clothed in a late 16th-century Deccan outfit: a long, fitted, front-opening saffron-gold silk jamah with subtle vertical self-stripes and a slightly flared skirt to mid-calf, buttoned down the front and cinched with a narrow brown leather belt; beneath it a high-necked, long-sleeved off-white cotton kurta with cuffs visible at the wrists; loose deep indigo churidar trousers ruched at the ankles, and sturdy mid-calf brown leather riding boots. A rich emerald-green dupatta with a thin gold border is draped from her left shoulder diagonally across her torso and around her back in a practical, secure wrap. She wears small gold hoop earrings, a single pearl-and-gold necklace, two slim gold bangles on each wrist and a simple gold seal ring on her right hand. At her left hip hangs a slightly curved Deccani tulwar with a steel blade and dark brown leather-wrapped hilt on a brown leather sword belt, while in her left hand she holds a rolled parchment scroll tied with a red cord. Emphasise consistent colours of saffron-gold, emerald green, deep indigo, off-white and brown leather, showing front, three-quarter and back views in the same outfit and hairstyle with clear visibility of the tulwar and scroll.
